description: The ponderal index (Rohrer's index) from weight and length: 100 x weight in grams / length in cm cubed, with the same quantity in kg per cubic metre. It is a newborn proportion measure; BMI-for-age is the usual measure for older children. It returns the number and does not place it against a range.
